NOVORA LINKENGINE
THIRD-PARTY NOTICE

Component:
NOVORA LinkEngine RelayCore

Derived from:
Genymobile/gnirehtet

Original project:
https://github.com/Genymobile/gnirehtet

License:
Apache License 2.0

NOVORA LinkEngine imports and adapts the IPv4 TCP/UDP relay core.

NOVORA does not execute the original gnirehtet.exe and does not use
the original Gnirehtet Android APK or its command-line/ADB lifecycle.

The Android VpnService, LinkEngine lifecycle, control channel,
recovery, device management and integration are implemented by NOVORA.
